findings.title: G6 A arm execution semantics do not match the G6/G7 protocol
findings.evidence: The G6 protocol defines G6_A_G3_GIVEN as the derived G3 Tools+Iteration arm. The frozen project runner scripts/run_g6_counterfactual.py instead gives G3 no tools, exactly two fixed-reflection model calls, and rejects G3 tool calls; docs/experiment_groups.md and configs/experiment_groups.json confirm the same implementation. The existing 552-row corrected subset therefore cannot be treated as a verified G6 Tools+Iteration run.
findings.remediation: Keep the historical G6 artifacts immutable. Freeze an explicit corrected G3 Tools+Iteration adapter, run it against the verified 23-family denominator with the same public inputs, matched G4 controls, hard limits, raw traces, and 2 workers; re-audit and use only the corrected handoff for G7.

findings.title: All eligible G6 public proof graphs have no dependency edges for G7 localization
findings.evidence: The 92 public cases in results/g6_counterfactual/formal-20261013T000000Z/public_cases_verified23.jsonl have 0 edges in every public_proof_graph. The corresponding 299 G5 proof_graph.json files also have 0 edges. G7 requires independently audited V/L/U labels and treats L as affected claim IDs plus dependency edges; the current artifacts do not supply observable dependency edges, so no edges may be invented for a formal G7 run.
findings.remediation: Preserve the old G5/G6 files unchanged. Either obtain an independently audited replacement proof-graph edge dataset with source hashes, or explicitly mark L-edge and U-injection analyses ineligible and run only the protocol-supported diagnostic subset; do not fabricate graph relations or claim complete failure localization.
